title: Launch choreography for CompactBurst instance family in Switzerland (ZH-2): GTM, release notes, and fallback plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Scope: Coordinate cross-functional GTM and ops for the CompactBurst instance family launch in the new Zurich (ZH-2) microregion. This ticket covers: release notes choreography, partner enablement docs, billing SKU mapping, fallback routing policy to neighboring regions, and a short ops runbook for post-launch stabilization.

Goals:
- Ship CompactBurst (g6c-compactburst) in ZH-2 with verified latency and cost profiles.
- Publish consolidated release notes and comms for customers and partners.
- Ensure safe rollouts with canary gates and an automatic fallback to FRA-1 if capacity or latency SLOs degrade.
- Provide billing and reservations mapping to existing reservation plans and a migration/override path for early customers.
acceptance_criteria: CompactBurst instance type available in ZH-2 and advertised in API model catalog with SKU mapping to existing reservation plans
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal and Security, and published to docs.redwood.ai/releases before GA
Canary traffic policy validated against latency SLOs (<60ms p95 for 32-token baseline) and autoscaling knobs exercised in staging
Fallback routing policy implemented: automatic reroute to FRA-1 within 90s when region capacity <10% or p95 latency >200ms
Partner enablement pack (one-pager + onboarding checklist + sample Terraform) published and shared with top 5 channel partners
Billing & metering tests completed: usage correctly attributed to CompactBurst SKU and reservation discounts applied where expected

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Unexpected p95 latency spikes from local ISPs - Mitigation: limit initial peak TPS per customer and enable fallback routing to FRA-1
Risk: Billing mis-attribution for reservation customers - Mitigation: run dedicated billing dry-run with invoices and revert plan ready
Risk: Partner confusion over SKU names - Mitigation: include migration table and sample Terraform in partner pack
Risk: Legal concerns around data residency wording - Mitigation: submit release notes to Legal 72h prior to GA and use approved template
post_launch_checks: 24h: Validate usage attribution for top 10 customers and confirm reservation discounts applied
48h: Confirm p95 latency and error rate stable; if >SLO then invoke rollback to FRA-1 routing
7d: Review cost-per-token telemetry and update Optimize recommendations if median cost delta >10%
30d: Run ops review and document lessons learned for runbook improvements
